output.content:
No defensible recipe can be selected from this characterization — the assessment is recorded as **needs_information**. When I ran the native LyoPRONTO model on the one allowed candidate pair (0.1 Torr chamber pressure, −15 °C shelf), the simulator refused because an essential input is absent.

**What the source supplies** (evidence record LPN-278e44d1be, revision 1, event time 2026-11-08 — a synthetic, authored simulator-world case, not experimental data): shelf ramp from −35 °C to −10 °C at 1.0 °C/min, chamber pressure ramp to 0.1 Torr at 0.5 Torr/min, vial heat-transfer coefficients KD 0.46 and KP 0.000893 cal/(s·cm²·K), product parameters (A1 19.1567, R0 1.4762 cm, T_pr_crit −5 °C on the vial-bottom temperature, cSolid 0.05 g/mL), vial geometry (Ap 3.14 cm², Av 3.8 cm², Vfill 2.053 mL), 398 vials, whole-batch equipment line a + b·P_Torr = −0.182 + 11.7·P kg/h, and a 3600-minute horizon.

**What is missing, exactly:** the vial heat-transfer constant **ht.KC** (the Kc term of the vial/shelf heat-transfer correlation) is not present in the evidence, and the simulator names it as a required characterized input it will not run without. Because of that, no flux, vial-bottom temperature, completion time, thermal margin or capacity margin could be simulated, and no result_ids exist.

The assessment draft (status: needs_information, no recipe selected) is saved for review. To proceed, an authorized characterization providing ht.KC in native units would let the 0.1 Torr / −15 °C pair be simulated and judged against the −5 °C bottom-temperature limit and the whole-batch equipment line.
